description: Source file implementing X11 window management and compositing for a Raspberry Pi 4 environment, including window creation, video frame compositing, and manual rendering with XRender.

classes.name: SbWindowPrivate
classes.description: Class managing an X11 window, including creation, compositing, and video frame rendering.

methods.name: HasNeededExtensionsForPunchedOutVideo
methods.description: Checks if the display supports necessary XRender and XComposite extensions for video punching.

methods.name: SbWindowPrivate::SbWindowPrivate
methods.description: Constructor initializing the X11 window, setting up visual info, colormap, and rendering surfaces.

methods.name: SbWindowPrivate::~SbWindowPrivate
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up X11 resources such as pixmaps, pictures, and windows.

methods.name: SbWindowPrivate::BeginComposite
methods.description: Prepares the composition buffer, resizing if necessary, and clears it.

methods.name: SbWindowPrivate::CompositeVideoFrame
methods.description: Uploads a video frame to an X11 pixmap and applies transformations for compositing.

methods.name: SbWindowPrivate::EndComposite
methods.description: Finalizes compositing by overlaying GL output and rendering the composed frame to the window.
